prompt: Create an exceptional Personal Brand Portrait Collection using the uploaded reference image as the exact facial identity source. Preserve the person’s identity with maximum fidelity: exact facial structure, eye shape and color, nose, lips, jawline, ears, hairstyle, facial hair, skin tone, natural skin texture, and distinctive facial characteristics. Do not beautify, reshape, slim, age, de-age, or replace facial features. Design a premium A4 vertical portrait presentation sheet containing 8 distinct editorial-quality photographs, not repetitive headshots. Every image must clearly depict the same person. Portrait Concepts 1. The Executive A powerful three-quarter portrait wearing a perfectly tailored charcoal suit and white shirt, standing beside a large floor-to-ceiling window overlooking a modern city skyline. Calm, confident expression. 2. The Creative Director Relaxed portrait in a sophisticated black turtleneck inside a dark contemporary studio filled with subtle architectural shapes, dramatic side lighting, sophisticated editorial atmosphere. 3. The Founder Seated naturally at a premium wooden desk inside a modern glass office, wearing a dark blazer over a minimal shirt. Laptop and subtle workspace elements in the background. Approachable, intelligent expression. 4. The Cinematic Portrait Close three-quarter portrait against a deep architectural background with controlled rim lighting, rich shadows, realistic skin texture, and a refined luxury campaign aesthetic. 5. The Casual Professional Smart-casual appearance with an elegant overshirt or premium knitwear, photographed outdoors beside modern architecture during golden hour. Natural posture and genuine subtle smile. 6. The Speaker Dynamic environmental portrait on a modern presentation stage with softly blurred auditorium lights behind the subject. Subject facing the camera confidently, conveying authority and communication skills. 7. The Minimalist Extremely clean studio portrait wearing a monochromatic outfit against an off-white architectural background. Soft natural lighting, generous negative space, premium magazine aesthetic. 8. The Signature Portrait Hero image with the subject standing confidently against a sophisticated dark gradient background, subtle rim light around the hair and shoulders, direct eye contact, relaxed confident expression, luxurious personal-brand campaign aesthetic. Visual Requirements • Each photograph must have a genuinely different composition, environment, wardrobe, and mood. • Maintain the exact same facial identity across all eight images. • Natural realistic skin pores and texture. • No plastic skin, excessive sharpening, face smoothing, or beauty-filter appearance. • Professional grooming while preserving the original hairstyle and facial hair. • Realistic hands and anatomy whenever hands are visible. • Sophisticated cinematic photography with physically accurate lighting. • Natural depth of field and realistic lens characteristics. • Premium editorial photography rather than generic corporate stock photography. • No logos, no watermarks, no random text, no distorted objects. Sheet Design Place the 8 photographs in an elegant 2 × 4 editorial grid on a clean warm-white A4 sheet. Give every photograph consistent dimensions and generous spacing. Add extremely subtle thin borders and minimal alignment marks. The overall result should resemble a luxury personal-brand photography contact sheet created by a professional creative agency, giving the subject eight completely different visual identities for use across websites, speaker profiles, social media, press kits, portfolios, business presentations, company profiles, and personal branding. Photorealistic, premium editorial photography, authentic identity preservation, sophisticated composition, natural skin texture, realistic lighting, exceptionally detailed.

promptZh: 使用上传的参考图像作为面部特征的唯一来源，创建一套出色的个人品牌肖像集。以最高保真度保留人物身份：精确的面部结构、眼睛形状与颜色、鼻子、嘴唇、下颌线、耳朵、发型、胡须、肤色、自然的皮肤纹理以及独特的面部特征。请勿进行美化、重塑、瘦脸、衰老、减龄或替换面部特征。设计一张高级的 A4 竖版肖像展示页，包含 8 张风格各异的编辑级照片，而非重复的头像。每张图像都必须清晰地呈现同一个人。肖像概念：1. 执行官：一张强有力的四分之三侧身肖像，身着剪裁完美的炭灰色西装和白衬衫，站在俯瞰现代城市天际线的大落地窗旁。表情冷静、自信。2. 创意总监：在充满微妙建筑形态的深色现代工作室中，身着精致的黑色高领毛衣，拍摄轻松的肖像，侧光戏剧化，具有高级的编辑氛围。3. 创始人：自然地坐在现代玻璃办公室的高级木质办公桌前，深色西装外套内搭简约衬衫。背景中有笔记本电脑和微妙的工作空间元素。表情平易近人且睿智。4. 电影感肖像：深邃建筑背景下的近景四分之三肖像，采用受控的轮廓光，阴影丰富，皮肤纹理真实，具有精致的奢侈品广告审美。5. 休闲专业人士：商务休闲装扮，穿着优雅的衬衫外套或高级针织衫，在黄金时刻的现代建筑旁进行户外拍摄。姿态自然，带有真诚而微妙的微笑。6. 演讲者：在现代演讲舞台上的动态环境肖像，背景是柔和模糊的礼堂灯光。主体自信地面对镜头，传达出权威感与沟通技能。7. 极简主义：极其干净的摄影棚肖像，身着单色服装，背景为米白色建筑。柔和的自然光，留白充裕，具有高端杂志审美。8. 标志性肖像：主视觉图像，主体自信地站在精致的深色渐变背景前，头发和肩膀周围有微妙的轮廓光，直视镜头，表情放松自信，具有奢华的个人品牌广告审美。视觉要求：• 每张照片必须具备真正不同的构图、环境、服装和情绪。• 在所有八张图像中保持完全一致的面部身份。• 呈现自然真实的皮肤毛孔和纹理。• 禁止塑料感皮肤、过度锐化、磨皮或美颜滤镜效果。• 在保持原有发型和胡须的基础上进行专业修饰。• 当手部可见时，确保手部和解剖结构真实。• 采用物理光照准确的精致电影感摄影。• 具备自然的景深和真实的镜头特性。• 呈现高端编辑级摄影效果，而非通用的企业库存照片。• 无 Logo、无水印、无随机文字、无物体畸变。排版设计：将 8 张照片以优雅的 2 × 4 编辑网格形式排列在干净的暖白色 A4 纸上。每张照片尺寸统一，间距充裕。添加极其微妙的细边框和极简的对齐标记。最终效果应类似于由专业创意机构制作的奢华个人品牌摄影样片，为拍摄对象提供八种完全不同的视觉形象，适用于网站、演讲者简介、社交媒体、新闻资料袋、作品集、商业演示、公司简介和个人品牌推广。照片级真实感，高端编辑级摄影，真实身份保留，精致构图，自然皮肤纹理，真实光影，细节极其丰富。
